title: S3 context-menu test never inspects the actual S3 context menu

evidence.quote:
let allowedTitles: Set<String> = [
            "Open Bucket",
            "Open Prefix",
            "Upload Files...",
            "Download...",
            "Download Unavailable for Prefixes",
            "Copy S3 URI",
        ]
        XCTAssertTrue(allowedTitles.isDisjoint(with: S3BrowserViewController.forbiddenLocalCommandTitles))

reasoning: This test does not construct an S3 browser view, trigger menu population, or compare the real menu items against the forbidden local-only commands. It only proves that a hand-written allowed-title set is disjoint from another static forbidden-title set, so a regression that adds a local-only command to the actual S3 context menu can pass untouched.
recommendation: Exercise the actual S3 menu-building path, or extract the menu-title builder into a testable helper, then assert the generated S3 menu titles are disjoint from the forbidden local-only command set.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing assertion never reads the actual menu contents.
suggestedRegressionTest: Seed an S3BrowserViewController state for empty, prefix, and object selections, call menuNeedsUpdate on an NSMenu, collect menu item titles, and assert no title appears in S3BrowserViewController.forbiddenLocalCommandTitles.
minimumFixScope: Update GroveTests/BrowserCapabilityTests.swift to validate generated menu titles rather than only comparing static sets.

history.reasoning: The original evidence path still exists at GroveTests/BrowserCapabilityTests.swift, but the quoted static allowedTitles assertion is gone. The current test now builds titles from S3BrowserViewController.contextMenuItems(for:location:) for empty, prefix, and object selections and checks them against forbiddenLocalCommandTitles. The actual S3 menu population in Grove/Controllers/S3BrowserViewController.swift:1087-1098 delegates directly to that same contextMenuItems(for:location:) helper, whose descriptors are defined at lines 1128-1157. That satisfies the recommendation to extract the S3 menu-title builder into a testable helper and assert generated S3 menu titles are disjoint from local-only commands. I attempted the narrow Xcode test, but the read-only sandbox prevented Xcode cache/result-bundle writes, so there is no live test pass evidence from this run.
